Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely inferred the film’s premiere timing by equating the opening of the 1964 New York World’s Fair (April 22, 1964) with the film’s earliest screening, without confirming a primary source for the film’s exact premiere date. This assumption introduced an unverified detail, though it did not affect the final (correct) conclusion about which film was released earlier.
